data_fields.name: rng_algo
data_fields.donor_constant: sodium (ChaCha20 keystream) default; gen5 (64-bit LCG) for old logs

data_fields.name: speed_tie_draws
data_fields.donor_constant: Fisher-Yates over each tie group: group size minus 1 draws

data_fields.name: turn_order_keys
data_fields.donor_constant: order low first, then priority high, speed high, subOrder low, effectOrder low

best_idea: One seed plus an ordered choice log rebuilds any fight exactly, and saving the RNG's position lets a fight resume mid-way.
decision_why: Keeps the seeded record and save/restore of the stream position for row 19 and server-verified kills; splits the single stream into named sub-streams and keeps GM actions out of the record (donor defects fixed, idea kept).
acceptance: A server test replays 200 stored duel records from seed and choices alone and asserts identical HP, log and kill result; a save-at-turn-5 test resumes and matches the uninterrupted run; changing only the loot table leaves duel hits unchanged.
